title: Coordinate-reversal duality of the truncated inputs
statement: Fix a positive integer $n$, and let $\omega$ be a sample of the hard distribution on $n$ coordinates. Form the dual sample by swapping Alice's and Bob's roles and reversing the coordinate order. Then Alice's truncated input vector in the dual sample — her bits up to and including the special coordinate, padded by $\mathrm{false}$ elsewhere — agrees coordinate-for-coordinate with the coordinate-reversal of Bob's truncated input vector in $\omega$, namely his bits from the special coordinate onward, padded by $\mathrm{false}$ elsewhere.
hypotheses_covered: omega is a sample of the hard distribution on n coordinates
replaced: Alice's $X_{≤T}$ vector in the dual is Bob's $Y_{≥T}$ vector in reverse order.
